name: Phia Oac–Phia Den National Park
nameVi: Vườn quốc gia Phja Oắc – Phja Đén
kicker: Moss forest on a 1,935 m summit
summary: Give Phia Oac its own day west of Cao Bang city. The road climbs from evergreen forest into moss and elfin forest, and the summit is 1,935 m. Skip it if Ban Gioc is the only day you have. This day is forest, not a second waterfall.
timeNeeded: A full day from the city
getThere: West from Cao Bang city. Drive minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Moss and cloud forest on Phia Oac

notice.title: This is not the waterfall day
notice.body: Phia Oac is west of the city. Ban Gioc is east, more than 80 km the other way. Putting them on the same afternoon drops one of them.

body: The park was set by decision 45/QĐ-TTg of 8 January 2014, on 11,960 ha, including moss forest and elfin forest. You drive up as the air cools. The first photograph is that moss, in cloud, with the trees still readable. It is not a summit panorama.

The summit named on the geopark’s western route is 1,935 m. UNESCO notes the eastern black crested gibbon in the geopark’s limestone forests. That sentence is not a promise you will see one on this road. The second photograph is the karst ridge above Phia Den, not the moss interior.

The western route also names a hanging valley, old mines, the Red Villa, Kolia tea, Tran Hung Dao Forest, and Phai Khat. Those stops stay off this page until a photograph is of that stop. The gate fee and the hours on the mountain are check on arrival. No price was on the western-route article or on the park decision page.

figures.caption: Karst ridges above Phia Den, on the western road
figures.alt: Forested karst peaks above a valley road in the Phia Oac–Phia Den reserve

gettingThere: Phia Oac is the western geopark day, out of Cao Bang city toward Nguyen Binh and the park. Minutes were not on the pages read. Hire a car or a motorbike in the city. Do not plan the drive after a late start if you also want the summit in daylight.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: West by car or motorbike. The drive itself is check on arrival for minutes. This is a full day, not a stop on the way to the falls.

closed: No weekly closing day was on the park decision page or the western-route article. Storm closures are check on arrival.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. No gate price was printed on the geopark’s western-route article or on the page that records decision 45/QĐ-TTg.
